summary: Replicated delegations reach the managed tenants they should, and several dead ends in daily work are gone.

new.title: Admins follow the delegations that need them
new.text: An admin account can be set to "Only where a delegation needs this admin", so it is created in a managed tenant exactly where a replicated delegation names it.

new.title: Set replication and ring in bulk
new.text: Tick rows in All records and use Set replication to... and Move to ring... in the selection bar.

fixes.title: Unpublished delegations are listed, not dropped
fixes.text: A replicated delegation whose admin is not replicated was silently dropped. It is now listed as not published, with the fix in the sentence.

fixes.title: Replicated rows must name a ring
fixes.text: A row set to replicate with an empty ring reached nobody. Saving such a row is now refused.

fixes.title: Cloning a row no longer blocks commits
fixes.text: A cloned row now gets its own group tag. Existing duplicates are listed, with Show me these rows and a one-click fix.

fixes.title: Waiting items no longer fail jobs
fixes.text: An item waiting for a group created in the same cycle is now reported as waiting, not as a failed job. It becomes a failure if it still waits hours later.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Removing an assignment updates the status at once, an already-removed Azure assignment counts as done, and the Access map, Commit selected and Backups / Undo are clearer.
